name: Post2Podcast
author: Samuel Bezerra

sections.description:
Post2Podcast turns a WordPress post into a podcast episode. It does not read the article aloud in one flat voice: it writes a short conversation between two hosts about your post, voices it with natural AI voices, and puts an audio player at the top of the post.

Your readers get a “listen to this article” option. You get a new format from content you already wrote, in about a minute per post.

Watch the 50-second demo:

How it works

  1. Open a post in the editor and find the Podcast Settings box.
  2. Pick a voice and a speaking style for each of the two hosts.
  3. Click Generate Audio. The MP3 is saved on your own site and the player appears in the post.

Features

  • Two-host conversations: a host and a co-host discuss your article, instead of a single text-to-speech voice reading it.
  • Natural AI voices: choose the voice of each speaker, preview voices in the editor, and describe the tone you want (“friendly and curious”, “calm and analytical”).
  • 19+ languages: the language of the post is detected and the episode is written and voiced in that language (English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi and more).
  • Waveform audio player: matches light and dark themes, with 1.5x and 2x playback speed and an optional MP3 download button.
  • Transcripts: download the transcript of every episode.
  • Podcast analytics: plays, unique listeners, listen time, completion rate, a retention funnel, devices, and a per-episode table with CSV export. No third-party cookies.
  • Bulk generation: turn your existing posts into episodes in one go.
  • Automatic episodes: every newly published post can get its episode without you doing anything.
  • Version history: restore a previous audio version, or delete an episode’s audio from the editor.
  • Posts and Pages: enable audio for Pages too.
  • Your files stay with you: MP3 files live in your WordPress uploads folder and keep working if you stop using the service.

Who it is for

  • Bloggers and newsletter writers who want an audio version of each article
  • News and magazine sites that want “listen to this story”
  • Educators and course creators turning lessons into audio
  • Businesses that want more accessible content

Free and PRO

Free: 10 episodes, up to 2 minutes each, all voices and languages. No card needed.

PRO, $19.90 per month: 300 episodes a month, no length limit, automatic episodes for new posts, bulk generation, ElevenLabs voices with your own ElevenLabs key, and priority support. Cancel any time; your episodes stay on your site.

More details: post2podcast.xyz

External services

To create an episode, the plugin sends the text of the post, your voice settings and your site address to the Post2Podcast service (https://post2podcast.fly.dev), which writes the script and produces the audio with AI models, then returns the MP3 to your site. This happens only when you generate an episode (or when automatic generation is on). The service also keeps your site’s credit and subscription status. Post text is not kept after the episode is produced.

The admin analytics page loads Chart.js from the jsDelivr CDN, and the player loads its waveform script from unpkg.com.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Post2Podcast”, then install and activate it.
  2. Open Post-to-Podcast in the admin menu and follow the setup step: create a WordPress Application Password in your user profile and paste it in. The service uses it to save the audio file to your site.
  3. Edit any post, open the Podcast Settings box, and click Generate Audio.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes, for the first 10 episodes (up to 2 minutes each). After that, PRO is $19.90 a month for 300 episodes with no length limit.

How is this different from other text-to-speech plugins?

Most audio plugins read the post word for word in one voice. Post2Podcast rewrites the post as a conversation between two hosts, which is easier to listen to for tutorials, news and long reads.

How long does an episode take to generate?

Usually between 30 seconds and 2 minutes. Very long posts can take up to 5 minutes.

Which languages are supported?

English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian and Finnish. The language is detected from the post.

Where are the audio files stored?

In your WordPress uploads folder, as MP3. They are part of your normal site backups.

What happens to my episodes if I cancel PRO?

Nothing. The files stay on your server and the players keep working. You only need credits to create new episodes.

Can I edit the audio?

Not directly. Change the voices or the speaking instructions and regenerate; the previous version stays in the version history.

Can I delete an episode?

Yes. Use Delete Audio under the player in the post editor, or next to the post in Post-to-Podcast → Settings.

Does it work with Pages?

Yes. Turn on “Pages-to-Podcast” in the settings.

Is the analytics tracking GDPR friendly?

Listening stats use anonymous session tokens and salted IP hashes, with no third-party cookies. You can turn tracking off in the settings.

Generation failed. What should I check?

  1. You still have credits (shown in the Podcast Settings box).
  2. The Application Password in the plugin settings is correct.
  3. The post has text content.
    If it still fails, open a support topic with your WordPress version and I’ll look into it.

The player is not showing. What should I check?

Clear your caching plugin first. Then check that the post has generated audio (the editor box shows a player) and that no other audio plugin is replacing the content.
